subject: BlueBrim onboarding: PO requirement / temporary invoice-only request
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin@bluebrim.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procure@bluebrim.com
Date: 2028-05-05T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding form + billing model question

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the onboarding packet — attaching the completed vendor intake form. One operational question before we proceed: our AP policy requires a single consolidated monthly invoice for pilots under $25k rather than per-PO chargebacks. For speed, can Redwood accept invoice-only billing for the 3-month pilot (estimated $18k total) with a short-term PO-waiver?

We can provide the signed onboarding form, a W-9, and insurance certs today. If you need a PO to set up billing in your system we can also generate a one-off PO number, but that will add procurement steps on our side which might push the start date. Any flexibility?

Best,
Erin Cole
Head of Partnerships — BlueBrim Analytics
attachments: bluebrim_onboarding_form.pdf, w9_bluebrim.pdf
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin@bluebrim.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-05T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + billing model question

Erin,

Appreciate the completed packet — received the onboarding form and W-9. Short answer: our standard practice for external suppliers is PO-required for any supplier billing to our corporate account. That said, we do have an established short-term exception path for pilots under $25k if certain controls are in place (evidence, single invoice cadence, PO-waiver signed by procurement and finance).

Next steps I propose:
- Please upload insurance certs to the Drive link (I shared folder)
- Fill the attached PO-waiver-request-form and return it to me
- I will route the waiver to Procurement (Marissa) and Finance (Priyom) for approval; they may request a temporary escrow or additional evidence depending on risk tier

If you can return the waiver today we can try to approve this week and not delay the start. If BlueBrim prefers to issue a PO now, we can accept that too — let me know which you prefer.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: po-waiver-request-form.docx
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-05T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: FWD: BlueBrim PO-waiver request — initial review

Olga / Priyom,

I reviewed BlueBrim's onboarding docs and the submitted waiver form. Quick notes from Procurement:
- Revenue exposure for pilot estimated $18k — low tier
- BlueBrim is an established analytics firm with public references; insurance and W-9 are in order
- We prefer suppliers to use PO where possible, but for pilots we allow invoice-only for <= $25k with (1) single monthly invoice, (2) invoice sent to AP with our internal reference BB-TRIAL-2028-05, (3) waiver signed by Procurement + Finance

Questions for Finance (Priyom): do we need additional controls (e.g., money holdback, escrow, or supplier credit check) for this case? If Finance signs off, Procurement can approve waiver and I will update our vendor portal to reflect invoice-only temporary flag.

Marissa
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-06T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: BlueBrim PO-waiver request — Finance input

Team,

Finance is comfortable with an invoice-only pilot for BlueBrim under these conditions:
- Total pilot spend capped at $25,000 (per the waiver)
- Single consolidated monthly invoice including our internal ref BB-TRIAL-2028-05
- Signed PO-waiver document with explicit approval fields for Procurement and Finance (I can sign)
- AP to perform a standard supplier credit check; if anything flags we reserve the right to require a PO or partial prepayment

I will sign the waiver once Procurement confirms. No escrow required for this spend level. Please confirm final waiver doc; Olga, can you route the signed waiver to DocuSign?

Regards,
Priyom Das
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin@bluebrim.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-07T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: temporary invoice-only path for BlueBrim pilot (BB-TRIAL-2028-05)

Erin,

Good news — Procurement and Finance have approved a temporary invoice-only billing path for your 3-month pilot. Conditions:
1) Pilot spend capped at $25,000 total.
2) BlueBrim will submit a single consolidated invoice monthly with line items and the internal ref BB-TRIAL-2028-05.
3) BlueBrim to upload insurance cert to shared Drive (confirmed).
4) Waiver document signed by Procurement (Marissa) and Finance (Priyom) via DocuSign (DocuSign link sent).
5) AP will run supplier credit check before the first invoice is paid.

I have attached the signed MPA redline (minor edits accepted) and initiated the DocuSign envelope for the PO-waiver-request-form. Please countersign at your earliest convenience so we can issue onboarding credentials and start the trial this week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting BlueBrim live.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
